In Appendix C "Cryptography Standards", Chapt. "AES Cipher Modes" a wrong linking was found: instead of linking to v11.2 / req. 11.2.3 there is a link to req. to 6.2.9, maybe from formaly version 4.0

comments.body:
Quote from the Appendix C:
> When using CCM-8, the MAC tag only has 64 bits of security. This does not conform to requirement 6.2.9 which requires at least 128 bits of security.

Current requirement v5.0.0-6.2.9
| # | Description | Level |
| :---: | :--- | :---: |
| **6.2.9** | Verify that passwords of at least 64 characters are permitted. | 2 |

We did not have requirement 6.2.9 in version v4.0.3, but during the re-org time, when we had the _bleeding edge version_ requirement v5.0.be-6.2.9 [was moved to](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/mappings/mapping_v5.0.be_to_v5.0.0.yml#L233C16-L233C29) v5.0.0-11.2.3
| # | Description | Level |
| :---: | :--- | :---: |
| **11.2.3** | Verify that all cryptographic primitives utilize a minimum of 128-bits of security based on the algorithm, key size, and configuration. For example, a 256-bit ECC key provides roughly 128 bits of security where RSA requires a 3072-bit key to achieve 128 bits of security. | 2 |
PR is reviewed and agreed by @randomstuff , PR merged.

title: App. C: wrong linking in AES Cipher Modes
